author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Hey folks
need a metaphor for me.
I am the target
what is the source?
Taking ideas please
let you define me
as I twist the source
of your sorcery
no like seriously
I want to write
an extended metaphor
poem
need a word
to
roam
#edu307
#smallpoems
